parsed.name: HDAWG 任意波形发生器
parsed.description: Zurich Instruments 的 HDAWG 高密度任意波形发生器，用于实验中输出高速可编程模拟波形，并通过外部参考时钟、AWG 通道和 DIO/码字接口与其他设备同步。该驱动包含默认设置加载、外部时钟确认、实时波形上传以及 DIO/AWG 调试可视化等功能，常用于量子控制等精密时序实验。
parsed.description_en: The Zurich Instruments HDAWG is a high-density arbitrary waveform generator used to produce high-speed programmable analog waveforms and synchronize with other instruments via an external reference clock, AWG channels, and DIO/codeword interfaces. This driver supports loading default settings, ensuring external clocking, real-time waveform upload, and DIO/AWG debug visualization, commonly for precision timing applications such as quantum control.

actions.description: 确保仪器使用外部参考时钟并检查同步状态。
actions.description_en: Ensure the instrument uses an external reference clock and verify its synchronization status.

actions.description: 加载默认设置，使仪器进入已知状态，包括外部时钟、输出清零、AWG 清空和 DIO 参数复位。
actions.description_en: Load default settings to bring the instrument into a known state, including external clock selection, output clearing, AWG clearing, and DIO parameter reset.

actions.description: 绘制 AWG 码字信息，用于检查和调试码字触发或数字控制配置。
actions.description_en: Plot AWG codeword information for inspecting and debugging codeword triggering or digital control configuration.

actions.description: 绘制 DIO 位快照，用于调试数字输入输出状态。
actions.description_en: Plot a snapshot of DIO bits for debugging digital input/output states.

actions.description: 向指定 AWG 实时上传波形数据。
actions.description_en: Upload waveform data to a specified AWG in real time.
